description_for_model: Genesis (iamazeyou.me) is an AI creative software platform (NAICS 511210 — Software Publishers) for visual storytelling, character design, and illustrated content generation. It is NOT a spiritual, wellness, religious, or personal development service. Users generate AI illustrations across three fiction and science themes: The Cosmos (sci-fi/space science), The Kingdom (fantasy fiction), The Cell (biology/microscience). An AI assistant named Gen guides the creative process. Subscription plans: Spark (free), Creator ($19.99/month), Studio ($59.99/month), Empire ($199.99/month). Commercial licensing on paid tiers. No prompt engineering required.
